method: Windows Ping.Send, 32-byte payload, 500ms timeout, 100ms between rounds
targetSelection: Remote address of the established krasis-agent socket on the saved profile port; verified not a local host address
discardedProbe: Initial saved-profile address was the local listening address. Its loopback-like observations were discarded and are not peer measurements.

limits: ICMP response scheduling may differ from the application's TLS input path.
